title: Jeevitham
desc: Rajan, a hardworking mechanic, leaves his home with his wife after facing troubles with his sons. Things take a turn when he builds a fortune of his own with his mechanic expertise.

title: Vishnu
desc: After escaping his father's control, a man builds a new life only to be torn between loyalty and truth when his past and present dangerously collide.

title: Pothan Vava
desc: Vava, a villager, goes through many troubles as he is born to a Christian mother and a Brahmin father. However, he is determined to prove to the society that love matters the most.

title: Peruvannapurathe Visheshangal
desc: Kunjulakshmi, pampered by her brothers, is somewhat arrogant. When she falsely accuses Sivashankaran, a peon, of misbehaving with her, he decides to teach her a lesson.

desc: The host reveals the ticket numbers and announces the names of the people from the state of Kerala who have won the lottery.

title: Kuttettan
desc: Although married, Vishnu is a habitual flirt and always looks out for an affair. When he is almost caught with a young girl in his house, he lies to his family that she is his illegitimate daughter.

title: Oru Kudumba Chithram
desc: A corrupt police officer tries to get Varunan involved in terrorist activities for his own gain. When he refuses, he kills Varunan's father and puts the blame on him.
